carriers.FRAME: SYNTH plus a two-instruction framing probe (6B falu2i then 2B mov_imm) immediately after the block under test
carriers.NAT: the probe kernel's own compiled archive, ONE byte spliced in place; operands LOADED from device buffers; result consumed by the COMPILER'S OWN device_store; observable = out[] in device memory; sentinels in a separate device buffer (index 4)
carriers.SYNTH: carrier_dag.metal's whole _agc.main replaced by a program assembled from tools/agx-isa's field rules, with the instruction under test lifted byte-for-byte; observable = 16 GPRs dumped + PRE/POST sentinel words

clean_room.inputs: kernels/probes.metal + kernels/carrier_dag.metal (authored by us) and the AGX machine code the PUBLIC Metal runtime API compiled FROM THEM

concurrency.lease: NOT taken -- sweeps run unlocked per FIELD-SWEEP-PROTOCOL sect 7

deliverable_constraints: no edits to db.json / validation.json / docs/ / PROVENANCE.md
gate: authored blob hashes below, NOT live HEAD (SUBAGENT_BRIEF; EXP-0082)

not_run.funary: funary.op overlaps a set match bit (DEF-0166-1); the descriptor needs repair before a sweep means anything
not_run.icmp_pred: EXP-0169 is concurrently building the divergent-block carrier
not_run.ilogic_predicate_consumed_pole: not reachable from our own MSL on G17P (isel10); recorded as instr_absent
not_run.packed_half2_hi: dropped: 3 blocking fields, one a 16-bit mods, and half-precision rounding leaves no exact host oracle

oracle.co_variation_check: PASSED at freeze -- NAT's read-back is the compiler's own device_store (a different instruction) and ilogic has no dst field; byte0 (which carries dst per DEF-0171-1) is swept ONLY on SYNTH. SYNTH dumps all 16 GPRs in a fixed order in every case. See PRE_REGISTRATION.md sect 5 and EXP-0140/EXP-0168's defect.
oracle.primary: HOST-COMPUTED, no GPU involvement, for every NAT integer kernel (harness/sweeprun.py::host_oracle_nat)
oracle.recorded_per_case: oracle.source names which one adjudicated the case; baseline_digest is recorded alongside so either adjudication can be redone offline
oracle.secondary: the measured unmutated baseline, for the SYNTH/FRAME register-file observable and every float/half/bfloat arm

promotion_rule.carrier_gates: F1 (byte0:=0 falsifier must be non-ok) and F2 (dense ladder byte must move) per carrier; a carrier failing either is DISCARDED, not reported as inertness
promotion_rule.coverage: distinct_bytes == encodable_range for the field's own bits, counted from raw (analysis/coverage.py); NEVER the dispatched-value count (DEF-0166-1)
promotion_rule.hygiene: sentinel_bad <= 1% of the field's cases; invalid_run cases never counted as evidence
promotion_rule.never_moved: promotable ONLY if the carriers differ in the dimension the field controls, named in the verdict row; unknown role -> single-template-inference, never hardware-run

findings_that_changed_the_design: DEF-0171-1 (ilogic byte0 match over-fitted to dst r0; b_alu10_lof/loe are the same instruction)
DEF-0171-2 (no length rule for byte0==0x31; G17P's own bfloat ALU does not tokenize; bf_alu's match and bf_fma_dst.fmt's enum do not describe what G17P emits)
fspecial_est subop == 0x0f on G17P, absent from db.json's enum
the predicate-consumed ilogic pole is not reachable from our own MSL on G17P (isel10 instead)
step0_precedes_freeze.what: harness/anchors.py -- compile our own MSL and tokenize it. NO GPU dispatch.
step0_precedes_freeze.why: so this contract can carry the exact case count and matrix hash rather than a promise; an underspecified frozen contract is an automatic stop (CODEX).

target.name: A18 Pro / G17P
target.note: the ONLY device dispatched to. The local M4 is retired for GPU work; M5 is out of scope.

verdict_keys_explicitly_disclaimed: *.dst (EXP-0168 owns the name on all 14 descriptors)
